context7.description: Latest library documentation lookup — use 'use context7' in prompts

git.description: Git history, blame, log, and diff access for current repository

github.description: GitHub REST API — PR creation, issue management, repo queries. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.

pdf-reader.description: PDF text extraction — read, search, and extract metadata from local PDF files

sequential-thinking.description: Structured multi-step reasoning chains — forces deliberate problem decomposition before acting

fetch.description: Fetch any URL and convert to clean text — docs, APIs, web pages

playwright.description: Browser automation — navigate, click, fill forms, scrape web pages (uses accessibility snapshots)

desktop-commander.description: Terminal control + file search + diff-based editing — long-running process management and interactive REPLs
